title: Mage Quarter
wikitext:
[[Image:The Mage Quarter.jpg|thumb|The Mage Quarter]]
The '''Mage Quarter''' lies in the southern corner of [[Stormwind City]]. The infamous [[Slaughtered Lamb]] tavern is located there, as well as the [[Wizard's Sanctum]]. Within the Sanctum, mages train to increase their powers, and there are also several portals in the tower. In the [[Slaughtered Lamb]], shady warlocks are often drawn to the dark cellars. Throughout the rest of the quarter, you can find [[herbalism]], [[alchemy]], and [[tailoring]] related stores and [[NPC]]s.

To get to the Mage Quarter, you can head southwest from the [[Trade District]] or southeast from the [[Park]].

== Notes ==
*There are a few night elves there despite them being unable to become mages nor warlocks.
